Alternative methods for making paneer and yogurt explored

Amidst concerns about milk availability, alternative methods for preparing paneer and yogurt have been highlighted. These methods involve using watermelon seeds to make paneer and peanuts to prepare yogurt. The coverage suggests these are experimental but viable options for home preparation.
